title: Cover Codex thread setup AutoApprove sandbox variants

acceptance: Parameterize the existing setup policy helper's sandbox or drive equivalent real setup paths, covering AutoApprove plus ReadOnly and AutoApprove plus DangerFullAccess at both thread/start and thread/resume.
